question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the word: **Garrulous**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Quiet**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Garrulous"** means excessively talkative, especially on trivial matters. (बातूनी)
 
 
• **Example:** The garrulous old man spent hours recounting his childhood tales.
 
 
 
• **"Quiet" **refers to a state of being silent or not making noise; it is the opposite of being talkative. (शांत)
 
 
• **Example:** She prefers quiet evenings at home rather than loud parties.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'garrulous' **is **'quiet'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Quiet**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Talkative** (बातूनी): Someone who speaks a lot, often excessively.
 
 
• **Example:** The talkative child kept interrupting the teacher during the lesson.
 
 
 
• **Loquacious **(बहुत बातूनी ): Another word for being excessively talkative.
 
 
• **Example:** Her loquacious nature made her a favorite at social gatherings.
 
 
 
• **Chatty** (गपशप करने वाला): Informal term for someone who enjoys chatting or talking casually.
 
 
• **Example:** He has a chatty personality and loves striking up conversations with strangers.
